decisions.contract: Reset is synchronous and active-high, sampled on the rising clock edge.
decisions.note: Brief states 'Reset clears the FIFO' but does not specify synchronous/active-high or sampling edge.

decisions.contract: Reset wins over read and write. Occupancy becomes zero; empty is true and full is false after the edge.
decisions.note: Brief does not address reset interaction with read/write or occupancy outcome.

decisions.contract: Reset may be asserted again at any later edge and must restore the empty state.
decisions.note: Brief does not mention if reset can be reasserted or its effect.

decisions.contract: Ignore the write.
decisions.brief_says: new bytes are dropped rather than overwriting stored ones
decisions.note: Matches contract: ignore write when full.

decisions.contract: Ignore the read. Nothing is consumed and nothing is bypassed.
decisions.note: Brief does not specify behavior on read when empty.

decisions.contract: Accept both. Occupancy stays constant; the old head is read and the new word joins the tail.
decisions.note: Brief does not address simultaneous read/write when neither empty nor full.

decisions.contract: Accept only the write. The new word is not bypassed to dout.

decisions.contract: Accept only the read. The write is ignored even though the read frees a slot.

decisions.contract: Accepted words leave exactly once and in arrival order, across pointer wraparound.

decisions.contract: dout is registered: it holds the removed word after the edge of an accepted read (no fall-through).
decisions.note: Brief does not specify dout registration or latency.
